runbooks.title: Roll back a bad deploy
steps: Freeze further deploys to the service
Roll back to the previous version
Confirm error rate and p99 latency return to baseline
Open a post-incident review for the change

runbooks.title: Database connection pool exhaustion
steps: Compare active vs. max connections on the pool dashboard
Find long-running transactions or batch jobs holding connections
Stop or reschedule the offending job; raise pool size temporarily only if the database has headroom
Add a statement timeout to prevent recurrence

runbooks.title: Upstream dependency outage
steps: Check the dependency's status page and contact its on-call
Verify circuit breakers are open and requests fail fast
Enable degraded mode or queue requests for retry
Post a customer-impact update

runbooks.title: Expired TLS certificate
steps: Identify the expired certificate (CN and where it is mounted)
Rotate the certificate from the secrets manager
Reload or restart the affected pods
Add expiry alerting 30 days ahead

runbooks.title: Memory pressure / OutOfMemoryError
steps: Check heap usage and GC pause dashboards
Capture a heap dump from an affected pod
Revert recent memory-related config changes or raise memory limits temporarily
Restart pods in a rolling fashion

runbooks.title: No anomaly / alert noise
steps: Compare metrics with the last 24h baseline
Check whether the alert threshold is too sensitive
Tune or silence the alert; no customer impact expected

runbooks.title: Service not found / missing telemetry
steps: Verify the service name and owner in the service catalog
Check that the service is emitting logs and metrics
Escalate to the owning team if customer impact is confirmed
